# iamencode Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    iamencode = {
      source = "winebarrel/iamencode"
    }
  }
}

output "policy" {
  value = provider::iamencode::policy({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"]
        Resource = "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"
      },
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "s3:ListBucket"
        Resource = "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket"
        Condition = {
          StringEquals = {
            "s3:prefix" = ["", "home/"]
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}
```
